data.description: Two-device runtime and FSDP2 probe; 360-second workload limit.

job_template_config.entrypoint_full_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export LAB_DEVICE=npu
if [[ "$LAB_DEVICE" == npu && -f /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh ]]; then
    source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh
fi
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
source = base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == '7cd12936085827fd3e8ca811c548bec60a373d77535e9980544bf5a64fc6c262'
Path('/tmp/training_infra_runtime_probe.py').write_bytes(source)
print('PROBE_SOURCE_SHA256=7cd12936085827fd3e8ca811c548bec60a373d77535e9980544bf5a64fc6c262', flush=True)
PY
exec timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 360s python3 -m torch.distributed.run --standalone --nproc_per_node=2 /tmp/training_infra_runtime_probe.py
